description:
The storage-format reference names the scratch directory as the commit point's home, describes publication as a redo record, and describes recovery as application at session open.

## Background

The reference is the canonical adopter statement of the repository layout and its write contract. It lists the data root's contents without the scratch directory, states that pending recoverable multi-file transactions live under a transactions subdirectory, names an external bootstrap control directory, and calls the whole thing a transaction, rollback, and mandatory-recovery contract. It also states the machine-local set kept out of version control, where the scratch directory's ignore entry belongs.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The data-root layout lists the scratch directory and states that it holds the pending redo record.
- [hard] REQ-02: The write contract describes publication as one synced redo record over the files a mutation writes, applied by replacement and removal.
- [hard] REQ-03: Recovery is described as idempotent application of a leftover record when a session opens.
- [hard] REQ-04: The page carries no description of rollback, a journal, a backup, a staging directory, a companion, or an external bootstrap control directory.
- [hard] REQ-05: The machine-local set states that the scratch directory is ignored and that the engine composes the ignore entry.
title: Storage format reference states the redo record
